name: agnes-image-video
description: Generate and download images or videos with Agnes AI models (agnes-image-2.5-flash, agnes-video-2.5-flash) through an OpenAI-compatible API on the China (api.agnes-ai.cn) or global (apihub.agnes-ai.com) endpoint. Supports text-to-image, text-to-video and image-to-video with async polling; no image-to-image. 生成图片、生成视频、文生图、图生视频，涉及 Agnes 模型时使用。
author: MONO
